info.title: Scam Detector Security Intelligence API
info.description: Evidence-grounded website risk investigations and AI explanations. Use a Scam Detector account API key (sd_live_...), never an OpenAI API key, to authenticate API clients. A low score or missing match is not proof that a website is safe.

post.description: Runs deterministic URL analysis and available live technical and threat-intelligence checks. Do not visit the submitted URL yourself. The result is evidence, not a guarantee of safety.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to investigate. Never include passwords, tokens or private query parameters.

200.description: Investigation result with findings, risk indicator, evidence, source status, limitations and scan_id.

post.summary: Ask Scam Detector AI about a scan or the service
post.description: Answers questions using a saved scan belonging to the authenticated account, or general published service capabilities when scan_id is omitted. Scan a URL first with investigateWebsite, then pass its scanId as scan_id for evidence-grounded follow-up questions.

scan_id.description: Optional scanId returned by investigateWebsite. Only scans owned by the authenticated account can be used.

401.description: Sign in or provide a valid Scam Detector API key.

404.description: Scan not found or not owned by the authenticated account.

503.description: AI integration not configured or provider temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Check scanner API and database health

ScamDetectorBearer.description: Create an API key in your Scam Detector account workspace. This is not your OpenAI Platform key.
